on_device_data: Corrected IPA installed in place after fresh readiness; no further app-data wipe or change to the clean iOS IPA, archived iPad app backup or Android source archive.
operator_observation: The main menu/tutorial became accessible. Code 26 appeared after selecting pet Suri, then code 26 appeared again after attempting to start a game. The game crashed immediately afterward. No playable level was observed; do not relaunch this unchanged failed build to confirm the crash.

new_game_process.evidence_limit: Original decoder, JSON, queued ID, token and result callback checkpoints passed for both mutations. These stages do not prove the iOS game accepted the business data or account state; neither code-26 popup maps uniquely to an observed failed request. No ID12 was queued in this process before the crash.

new_matching_crash.crash_location: Original iOS executable ARM Thumb VM 0x0e387a (physical PC 0x0015987a, mapped slide 0x76000), not the newly appended native offline segment.
new_matching_crash.machine_invariant: Crash ARM r6 is zero; link register minus verified app slide is original VM 0x4c007. At original VM 0x4bfea the direct caller runs original selected-model lookup 0xded18, stores its null result in r6, checks it, but still calls original two-slot accessor 0xe3870 with r0=0 and index r1=1. The original accessor dereferences 0x18. Missing selected-model entry is verified; whether caused by stage.dat, inventory, profile, or another producer is not proven.
new_matching_crash.temporal_boundary: Original queued ID11 pocket.set callback was logged during the same second as the matching game-process crash.
new_matching_crash.read_only_app_state: AFC2 read only the exact matching game's Documents directory and checksum-validated local offline state. Owned item slot 0, original ability level 1, and a positive GameStart counter persisted; the selected original model was not thereby initialized. The archived stage.dat is malformed and was never imported, but a causal link to this crash is unproven.

privacy: Only process-scoped numeric markers, original executable PCs, error type and the operator's screen report are recorded; no raw identity, token, request parameters, USB identifier, copied filename, unrelated app logs or memory data are published.
